NumJarTypes.definition: Number of different types of terracotta jars produced

ShapingTimePerType.definition: Amount of shaping time required to produce one unit of each jar type

BakingTimePerType.definition: Amount of baking time required to produce one unit of each jar type

ProfitPerType.definition: Profit earned per unit of each jar type

ShapingTimeAvailable.definition: Total amount of shaping time available per week

BakingTimeAvailable.definition: Total amount of baking time available per week
